summary: WISeKey International Holding filed a Form 6-K attaching a CEO letter to shareholders. The letter reviews 2025 financial results, Q1 2026 revenue growth of 200%, balance sheet improvement to $535M cash, and progress on SEALSQ, WISeSat, and the SEALSQ Quantum Fund. No transaction, special-situations event, or corporate action is announced—only narrative business updates. This is a routine regulatory filing without deal terms, structural changes, or an activist campaign. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special situation.
